new_articles.title: An inside look at SK Hynix $720 billion AI-fueled buildout that's taking over South Korea
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'An inside look at SK Hynix $720 billion AI-fueled buildout that's taking over South Korea'이다. SK Hynix, the leading maker of high-bandwidth memory, is pouring $720 billion into memory factories to meet AI demand. We got an exclusive first look. Jeniece Pettitt SK Hynix reported in July that it signed 10 long-term agreements with major customers MS Hwang, research director at Counterpoint Research, said all the hotels near SK Hynix and Samsung's memory fab expansions are fully booked In addition to its Indiana plans, SK Hynix has existing U chip fab plans, Tae-won said SK Hynix has been studying possible sites for more than a month In the meantime, Tae-won said memory is at a "turning point" with the next technological leap to custom HBM that will help insulate SK Hynix's massive investment from risk. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: Mirae Asset Venture raises Rs 1,125 crore in first close of new India-dedicated fund
new_articles.summary: Mirae Asset 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Mirae Asset Venture raises Rs 1,125 crore in first close of new India-dedicated fund'이다. This compares with the firm’s first flagship fund, which had a corpus of Rs 370 crore, and a late-stage vehicle it launched with a corpus of Rs 700 crore. ETtech Puneet Kumar, CEO, Mirae Asset Venture Investments (India) Mirae Asset Venture Investments India , which has backed new-age companies such as Shadowfax, Dhan, Snabbit and KreditBee, has raised Rs 1,125 crore in the first close of its second flagship fund for India, as it looks to back startups in the early-growth stages amid a tougher funding environment for technology companies Mirae Asset said the fund will focus on raising capital domestically following the first close Mirae Asset’s focus on the early-growth segment places it between traditional early-stage venture capital and larger growth-equity investors With Mirae Asset Venture Opportunity Fund-II, we want to partner with founders at this important stage of their journey and help them build large, enduring companies,” he said Mirae Asset Group said it globally managed more than $800 billion in assets as of March 31, 2026. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

Kia India plans to expand its manufacturing capacity to meet future demand. The automaker targets annual sales of 410,000 vehicles by the year 2030. Kia will introduce ten new vehicles, with eight being electrified models. The company is also expanding its network into smaller Indian cities. This expansion aims to serve both domestic customers and increase exports. Reuters Kia plans to expand India capacity as sales growth accelerates New Delhi: South Korea’s Kia Corp plans to expand its car manufacturing capacity in India to meet expected growth in domestic sales and overseas demand The automaker, which clocked 17% sales volume growth to 191,949 vehicles in the first seven months of 2026, is targeting annual sales of 410,000 vehicles by 2030, Atul Sood, senior vice-president, marketing and sales at Kia India, told ET ” India is the fourth-largest market for Kia, accounting for 10% of its global sales Also Read: Kia India to raise vehicle prices by up to 2% from July 1 Data from the road ministry’s Vahan portal showed that electric car sales in India surged 90% year-on-year during March-July 2026 Kia is also working on widening its pan-India network by entering more Tier 3 and Tier 4 cities.

matched_articles.title: Why does SK Hynix want to sell its chip facility in southwest China?
matched_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Why does SK Hynix want to sell its chip facility in southwest China?'이다. South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix’s potential deal to offload a packaging plant in southwest China is part of a strategic pivot towards higher-margin artificial intelligence memory products, according to analysts. But they cautioned a sale might not be straightforward, as the memory chip giant would need to navigate valuation hurdles and a volatile chip cycle. SK Hynix said on Monday it was “looking into various solutions to enhance the competitiveness of its packaging business”, after reports. . The South Korean chipmaker wants to pivot towards the high-margin AI memory sector, but analysts warn any sale would face valuation hurdles 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN 1 Listen Ann Cao in Shanghai and Howard Liu in Beijing Published: 10:00am, 12 Aug 2026 Updated: 5:08pm, 12 Aug 2026 South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix’s potential deal to offload a packaging plant in southwest China is part of a strategic pivot towards higher-margin artificial intelligence memory products, according to analysts SK Hynix said on Monday it was “looking into various solutions to enhance the competitiveness of its packaging business”, after reports emerged last week it was weighing options for its facility in Chongqing, a megacity in China’s southwest SK Hynix said in a statement that no final decisions had been made The Chongqing plant functions as a back-end hub focused on downstream packaging and testing for SK Hynix’s NAND flash memory products com, described SK Hynix’s decision as a strategic shift from low-value back-end assembly to high-margin front-end manufacturing. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
